name: Laurentiu Possa
biography: Laurentiu Possa is a world-wide known artist best loved for his role as Guzmin, in 'Modern Love' (2019) - When the Doorman IS Your Main Man with Cristin Milioti. As Vladimir in 'Killing Eve' (2018) he gave a compelling performance alongside Sarah Oh, Fiona Shaw and Kim Bodnia. Still with his first manager, Suzann Wade, Laurentiu being a linguist has played a myriad of roles, like Russian cop (2007) in Bourne Ultimatum, and a Chechen dissident for BBC Radio 4 in Forty Three, Fifty Nine (2009), the doppelgänger role utilising his Romanian and Spanish language skills (playing Rene and The Spanish Ambassador in Sherlock Holmes - A Game of Shadows (2011)). Fluent in Latin, he enjoys perfecting his Portuguese, Italian, French (as Octavian in Extraordinary Rendition (2007)), Romany and Serbian languages as well as his American accent. In Gaming, Laurentiu is best known for: Total War: Attila - The Black Horse (2013), GoldenEye (2010) and James Bond 007 - Blood Stone (2010). He is a keen gardener, health enthusiast and nothing is too good for his little Gracey - his beloved wide eyed cat.
